requirements.verifier_assertion: cargo build --bin uv from /app must succeed and the resulting binary must exist at /app/target/debug/uv (tests/test_outputs.py:35, :37).
uv --version returns 0; uv auth --help returns 0 and lists login/logout/token/dir; uv pip --help still returns 0 (existing commands untouched) (tests/test_outputs.py:78–87).
A bare-domain SERVICE gets `https://` prepended automatically before storage/display (tests/test_outputs.py:258–259).
http://... is rejected at argument-parsing time with stderr containing `only HTTPS is supported` (exit 2); an unparseable service is also rejected with exit 2 (tests/test_outputs.py:264–270).
must_include: URLs that cannot be parsed are likewise rejected

requirements.verifier_assertion: SERVICE paths ending in /simple or /+simple (case-insensitive, trailing slash tolerated) are normalized to the index root before storage; non-index paths are preserved; login and logout share the same normalization so `.../simple` and its root address the same entry (tests/test_outputs.py:278–329).

URL-embedded credentials are accepted; user@host combines with --password; supplying username in BOTH URL and CLI is rejected with stderr `Cannot specify a username both via the URL and CLI`; supplying password in BOTH the URL and CLI is rejected with `Cannot specify a password both via the URL and CLI`; --token combined with any URL-embedded credentials is rejected; the username-conflict rule applies to login, token, and logout (tests/test_outputs.py:341–388).
must_include: Cannot specify a username both via the URL and CLI
Cannot specify a password both via the URL and CLI
credentials embedded in the URL must also be rejected

requirements.verifier_assertion: login --token combined with --password exits 2; login --token combined with --username exits 2 (tests/test_outputs.py:397, :400).

Non-interactive login with no username errors with stderr `No username provided` (exit 2); with a username but no password errors with `No password provided` (exit 2). login/logout/token invoked without a SERVICE argument exit 2, and login's error message contains `SERVICE` (tests/test_outputs.py:404–418).
must_include: SERVICE is a required positional argument

requirements.verifier_assertion: On successful login, stderr contains `Stored credentials for` and the display URL uses `<username>@https://<normalized_host>/` (for a username login) or the URL only (for a token login, with `__token__` never appearing in stderr) (tests/test_outputs.py:99, :100, :132, :133, :135).
login does not remote-validate credentials; storing a wrong password still exits 0 (tests/test_outputs.py:148).
must_include: storing a wrong password does not error

requirements.verifier_assertion: A login with --token records the entry under the fixed `__token__` username placeholder; `__token__` never appears in stderr output; a subsequent `token` invocation with no --username retrieves that entry (tests/test_outputs.py:131–140).

logout with no --username removes the `__token__` entry by default (exit 0, stderr `Removed credentials for <display URL>`); if the store contains only a username entry, the default logout returns exit 2 with `No matching entry found for` (tests/test_outputs.py:226–246).

On successful logout, stderr contains `Removed credentials for` with the same display-URL rules as login (`user@https://host/` for a username entry; URL-only for a token entry with no `__token__` leaked) (tests/test_outputs.py:207, :208, :231, :232, :233).

When logout finds no matching entry, it exits 2 with stderr `No matching entry found for <display URL>`, where the display URL uses the normalized service address (tests/test_outputs.py:218, :219, :245, :246, :329).

On a token hit, the password/token is printed verbatim to stdout on its own line (exit 0); `Stored credentials` and other status lines must never appear on stdout (tests/test_outputs.py:140, :165, :166, :191, :285, :289, :302, :346, :436, :448, :538).

On a token miss, exit 2 with stderr containing `Failed to fetch credentials for <display URL>`; the display URL uses the service address as GIVEN in the request, including any URL-embedded username (e.g. `wronguser@https://host` when --username wronguser was passed) (tests/test_outputs.py:170, :171, :176, :177, :178).
must_include: including any username embedded in the URL

requirements.verifier_assertion: A credential stored for `https://host/` must also match a token lookup on a deeper path such as `https://host/simple` — prefix matching on the request URL (tests/test_outputs.py:185, :190, :191).
must_include: must also be found when querying with a deeper path

requirements.verifier_assertion: The default backend is a plaintext TOML file at `<UV_CREDENTIALS_DIR>/credentials.toml`; storage is plaintext (no encryption / no encoding — the username, password and host all appear as bare strings in the file); UV_CREDENTIALS_DIR overrides the storage directory (tests/test_outputs.py:104, :122, :123, :124, :459).
Multiple usernames under the same service coexist independently; removing one leaves the other retrievable (tests/test_outputs.py:430, :435, :436, :441, :444, :447, :448).
must_include: different usernames under the same service must coexist
removing one username's entry must leave others untouched

requirements.verifier_assertion: Concurrent parallel logins (8 processes) all exit 0 and each credential is retrievable afterwards — writes are cross-process visible and lock-protected so the file cannot be corrupted (tests/test_outputs.py:511, :532, :537, :538).
must_include: Concurrent writes to the file must be protected by a lock
must not produce a corrupted file

requirements.verifier_assertion: `uv auth dir` returns `UV_CREDENTIALS_DIR` on stdout when set; when unset, stdout contains `/.local/share/uv/credentials` (uv's default state dir) (tests/test_outputs.py:457, :459, :473, :474).

login/logout/token accept `--keyring-provider disabled` and the `UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=disabled` env var, and in both cases still use the plaintext-file backend end-to-end (tests/test_outputs.py:486, :490, :491, :497).

Exit codes across all commands follow uv's convention: 0 on success, 2 for both usage errors and runtime errors (mapping in crates/uv/src/commands/mod.rs). Every non-zero verifier assertion in test_outputs.py compares against exactly 0 or 2.
must_include: exit 2 for both usage errors and runtime errors
